title: agent-trace canonical event (v2)
description: The canonical execution-trace event every adapter converges on. One event is one line of JSONL. span_start + span_end with the same span_id form a Span; type=event records a discrete occurrence. This file is the authoritative contract — Python constants in core/schema/model.py are derived from it and pinned by test/v2_schema.test.py.

event_id.description: globally unique id of THIS event. Adapters that re-emit (importers, hooks) must derive it deterministically from source identity so re-ingestion deduplicates instead of doubling.

type.description: span lifecycle marker, or a discrete event

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC ms — when the observed thing happened, per the adapter's best knowledge

observed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC ms — when the adapter wrote the event. ts < observed_at is normal for file-parsing adapters (codex); a gap flags derived data.

sequence.description: source ordering hint when the agent provides one; null otherwise

session_id.description: the continuous agent session this belongs to; null only for events that genuinely have no session

trace_id.description: one task execution. Required on span_start/span_end; session-level events (session_start) carry null.

span_id.description: required on span_start/span_end; both markers of one span share it

parent_span_id.description: parent span within the same trace; null on the root (task) span

adapter_id.description: which adapter produced this (hermes, codex, pi, langgraph, ...). Deliberately an open string, NOT an enum: adding an adapter must not require editing the schema.

agent_name.description: the agent product being observed (usually equals adapter_id; differs when one adapter serves several agents)

kind.description: task = trace root; agent = subagent delegation; llm = one model call; tool = one tool execution; chain = generic grouping

status.description: span_start: running or absent. span_end: one of the four terminal states. 'incomplete' is NEVER emitted — it is assigned by the materializer to a start that saw no end.

input.description: span_start payload: messages/args/task description, already truncated and redacted by the adapter

attributes.description: controlled extension point for agent-specific data: provider/model/api_mode/usage for llm spans, exit_code for tools, delegation info for agent spans. Core fields stay stable; adapters put the rest here.

name.description: open string. Well-known: session_start, session_end, user_prompt, assistant_message, note

resource.description: process/machine context: pid, cwd, runtime, host

privacy.description: how this event was treated BEFORE it hit disk, so a reader can distinguish 'empty' from 'withheld'

source.description: traceability back to the raw artefact: source event id, file, byte offset

then.description: a span marker is meaningless without its identity and payload
an end marker must reach a terminal state
